# Aurora Robotics Inc. — Annual Report 2022

## Letter from the CEO

2022 was a year of rapid expansion for Aurora Robotics. We launched the Falcon Drone v2, our most significant hardware upgrade to date, and we opened our second office in Austin, Texas to support growing demand in the central United States. We also completed our first acquisition, bringing LIDAR sensing technology in-house. It was a year of real momentum, and I'm grateful to the 275 people who make up this company today.

— Elena Marsh, Chief Executive Officer

## Financial Highlights

Aurora Robotics Inc. reported total revenue of $58.7 million for fiscal year 2022, an increase of 38.7% over fiscal year 2021's revenue of $42.3 million. Net income for the year was $5.4 million. Research and development spending increased to $11.5 million as we invested heavily in the Falcon Drone v2 hardware refresh and in integrating LIDAR capability following our acquisition of SkyMetrics.

Headcount grew from 210 employees at the start of the year to 275 employees by December 31, 2022.

## Business Overview

In March 2022, Aurora Robotics acquired SkyMetrics, a small startup specializing in compact LIDAR sensors for aerial platforms. This acquisition allowed us to bring high-precision 3D mapping capability directly into our own hardware rather than relying on third-party sensor vendors.

In the third quarter of 2022, we opened a second office in Austin, Texas, to support sales and field service operations across the central and southern United States. This office was staffed with 25 employees by year end, primarily in field services and regional sales.

We also launched the Falcon Drone v2 in Q4 2022, featuring a significantly longer flight time, higher payload capacity, and the newly integrated LIDAR sensor from the SkyMetrics acquisition.

## Outlook

For 2023, management expects continued growth in both the industrial inspection and agricultural verticals, along with further expansion of our Austin office. We anticipate increased investment in field service infrastructure to support our growing installed base of Falcon Drone v2 units.
